text.text_excerpt: I got a half-dozen glazed donuts just to try this place out. I figured if they cannot get that right, no point in trying anything else. I was pleasantly surprised! They glazed donuts are bigger, fluffier, and have a better taste than chain store competitors. This location just opened a few days ago, and if this experience is any indication of the rest of their selection (which looked pretty impressive) they will be in business for a long time. Go check these guys out if you're in NOLA!

Just opened about 2 weeks ago, so of course I had to check it out! I love the fact that's it's open 25/8! Yep, like it says on their door...25/8. If you're up studying all night, up late working on a work project or whatever come get some late night donuts. I tried the German chocolate donut.I must say was a little bit dry but after 15 sec's in the microwave it was perfection (you're welcome). The variety of options is plentiful. Needless to say, I will be trying out a few more varieties. The Cookie Monster donut is adorable & some of the donut names are so cute. Reese's pieces donut....well it's the ET duh! UPDATE! I don't like donuts. All right, hang on, let me explain. I don't think donuts are bad, and I wouldn't turn down a free one. But "donut" by itself tends to refer to yeast donuts, whereas I greatly prefer cake donuts. This is important. Ended up at Hurts on a weekday. First thing I noticed with her signs about their COVID hours; not currently the "25/8" they would normally operate by. Walking in, the place seemed nice enough for a donut shop, and the wide display a varied colorful donuts was tempting.
